name: Laibin New Energy Data Center
developer: Digital Guangxi Group Co., Ltd. / Guangxi Investment Group
notes: Guangxi's first source-grid-load-storage new-energy data center broke ground in Laibin on 2024-03-29; reported total investment is about RMB 1.5 billion, with 3 IDC buildings, 67,100 sqm, 7,515 5 kW cabinets, and phase 1 planned for 500 intelligent-computing cabinets / 1025P compute. 2024-09 procurement records show phase 1 MEP design award.

name: Liuzhou Big Data Industrial Park Data Center
developer: Guangxi Liuzhou Beicheng Investment Development Group Co., Ltd.
notes: Liuzhou SASAC reported the park's start with planned 20,000 cabinet groups and phase 1 target of 10,000; People's Daily Guangxi later described phase 1 as 124 mu and 283,000 sqm including a data center, and Guangxi Daily listed the data center as a Digital Guangxi benchmark project.

name: China Mobile (Liuzhou) Luowei Data Center Phase II
notes: Liuzhou municipal and Yufeng district pages describe construction at the Luowei Industrial Concentration Zone; tender/project aggregators list a new-build phase II data-center project with 12,300 sqm and a planned 2022-11 to 2024-02 construction window.

name: China Mobile (Guangxi) Data Center, Nanning Wuxiang New Area
notes: Located in Nanning Wuxiang New Area Big Data Industrial Park; phase 1 was put into production/fully completed in 2022. Official/free-trade-zone materials report total planned investment of RMB 2.5 billion, 82.3 mu, about 106,000 sqm, and more than 13,000 racks.

name: China Telecom ASEAN International Information Park Data Center
notes: China Telecom's Wuxiang New Area data center received CQC A-grade data-center certification in January 2024; earlier official/tender materials show the ASEAN International Information Park was approved in Liangqing District and built as an international IDC/cloud-computing hub.

name: China-ASEAN Information Harbor Nanning Wuxiang COSCO Big Data Industrial Park
developer: China-ASEAN Information Harbor / Nanning Wuxiang New Area stakeholders
notes: Nanning and Guangxi free-trade-zone sources identify the Wuxiang COSCO Big Data Industrial Park as part of the Nanning core base; the same official materials state Nanning had 20 built/under-construction internet data centers and 116,000 standard-rack planned carrying capacity.

name: China-ASEAN (Qinzhou) Huawei Cloud Computing and Big Data Center
developer: Qinzhou Yungu Technology Development Co., Ltd.; Huawei Technologies
notes: Project in Qinzhou High-tech Zone is Huawei's sole Guangxi public-cloud node in the cited announcement, planned in three phases with about 60,000 sqm and 6,000 T3-standard cabinets; phase 1 planned 13,000 sqm and 1,000 cabinets. Guangxi Daily later listed it as a Digital Guangxi benchmark big-data center.

name: ZTE Wuzhou Smart Guangxi Cloud Data Center / ZTE Guangxi Cloud Data Center
developer: ZTE Communications / Guangdong-Guangxi Cooperation Special Experimental Zone stakeholders
notes: Guangxi's Greater Bay Area connection plan names ZTE Wuzhou Smart Guangxi Cloud Data Center phase 1 as a priority platform project; Xinhua/China Daily and Wuzhou Daily coverage from 2017 said the ZTE Guangxi cloud data center project in the special experimental zone was under construction or site preparation.

name: Yulin Cloud Computing Big Data Center / Zhuangmei Guangxi Yulin Government Cloud
developer: Yulin Big Data Development and Government Service Bureau; China Unicom Yulin Branch; Huawei Kunpeng ecosystem
notes: People's Daily Guangxi reports the Huawei Kunpeng-based 'Zhuangmei Guangxi - Yulin Government Cloud' went online in October 2020 and built the Yulin cloud-computing big-data center; 2026 procurement files refer to ongoing service continuity for 47 agencies and 73 systems at the center.

name: Guizhou (Anshun) Data Center and Technology Incubation Center
developer: Guizhou Guodian Nanzi Smart City Development Co., Ltd.; Huawei Cloud platform partner
notes: Huawei Cloud announced a strategic cooperation/order for the Guizhou (Anshun) data-center cloud platform with Anshun Economic and Technological Development Zone and Guodian Nanzi; local/industry sources place the project on Xinghuo Road, Anshun ETDZ, with RMB 1.5 billion total investment and phase 1 around 1,200 high-density cabinets.

name: China Telecom Cloud Computing Guizhou Information Park, Gui'an New Area
notes: China Telecom identifies the Guizhou Information Park as one of its two major cloud-computing data centers, planned at 340,000 sqm with 29 data buildings, 50,000 racks and 800,000-server capacity; Guizhou big-data bureau materials describe it as Gui'an New Area's first data center to start construction and enter operation.

name: China Unicom Gui'an Cloud Data Center
notes: Reported as China Unicom's largest southern China cloud data center, located in Gui'an New Area, with 480,000-server installed capacity and more than 4,000G export bandwidth; later official/media coverage highlights it as part of the Guiyang-Gui'an data-center cluster.

name: China Mobile Guizhou / Guiyang Big Data Center, Gui'an New Area
notes: China Mobile's Guizhou/Guiyang big-data center is described as one of China Mobile's major cross-provincial data centers and a national disaster recovery center; reported scale includes about 19 ha/275 mu planning, 19,000 sqm building area, 21,000 racks and 320,000-server capacity.

name: Tencent Gui'an Qixing Data Center
notes: Tencent's Qixing Data Center in Gui'an New Area is repeatedly cited as a cavern-based data center and national 'east data west computing' example; sources report it can host more than 200,000 servers and uses Tencent modular T-block design.

name: Huawei Cloud Gui'an Data Center / Huawei Gui'an Cloud Data Center
notes: Public sources describe Huawei's Gui'an data center as Huawei's largest global cloud data center, located in the Gui'an New Area electronic information industrial park; reported design can accommodate up to one million servers, with low PUE and use as a global IT maintenance/training base.

name: Apple / Guizhou-Cloud Big Data iCloud Data Center, Gui'an New Area
developer: Apple; Guizhou-Cloud Big Data Industry Co., Ltd.
notes: Apple's first China data center, jointly built with Guizhou-Cloud Big Data in Gui'an New Area, commenced operation in May 2021; announced contracted investment was about USD 1 billion to support mainland China iCloud services.

name: NetEase Gui'an Data Center
notes: NetEase's first self-built large data center in Gui'an New Area started phase 1 construction in February 2023; People's Daily Guizhou reported a planned 2023 delivery timetable, and later China Daily coverage still described the facility as under construction to host NetEase core services.

name: National Supercomputing Center in Guangzhou Guizhou Branch, Nanming District
developer: Nanming District Government; Sun Yat-sen University / National Supercomputing Center in Guangzhou
notes: Nanming District and Sun Yat-sen University signed in August 2023 to build the Guizhou branch of the National Supercomputing Center in Guangzhou; 2024 official/Xinhua coverage says the branch had landed in Nanming's Asia-Pacific Center and was adding ecosystem partners for HPC, AI and big-data applications.

name: Block Data IDC Data Center / Guiyang City Cloud Security Operations Center
developer: Guiyang Block Data City Construction Co., Ltd.
notes: Guiyang Block Data City Construction procurement and Guizhou Big Data Bureau project-list materials identify the Block Data IDC Data Center / Guiyang City Cloud Security Operations Center as a data-center-class project in Guiyang's high-tech zone.
